title: XML Document
description: JSON Schema describing the metadata and high-level structure of an XML document, including version, encoding, namespaces, doctype declaration, processing instructions, and the root element.

version.description: XML version declared in the XML declaration.

encoding.description: Character encoding declared in the XML declaration.

standalone.description: Whether the document is standalone (no external markup declarations affect the content).

name.description: Root element name declared in the DOCTYPE.

publicId.description: Public identifier of the external DTD subset.

systemId.description: System identifier (URI) of the external DTD subset.

processingInstructions.description: Processing instructions declared at the document root.

namespaces.description: Namespace declarations in scope on the root element.

prefix.description: Namespace prefix (empty string for default namespace).

rootElement.description: Local name of the root element.

schemaLocation.description: Optional xsi:schemaLocation value pairing namespaces to schema URIs.

noNamespaceSchemaLocation.description: Optional xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation value for documents without a target namespace.

validation.description: Validation status and metadata for the document.

wellFormed.description: Whether the document is well-formed per the XML specification.

valid.description: Whether the document is valid against the declared DTD or schema.

schemaType.description: Type of schema used for validation.

modified.description: Date the document was last modified.
